body_markdown:
*Solstice plans to begin sampling with selected global customers in early 2027, demonstrating the strength of its innovation pipeline and increased R&D investment*


*Based on the company's internal evaluation, the developmental candidate is well-positioned because it would not be classified as PFAS 1*


MORRIS PLAINS, N.J.


, Nov. 9, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Solstice Advanced Materials](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4817961-1&h=1474660449&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solstice.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fhome&a=Solstice+Advanced+Materials) (Nasdaq: SOLS), a global leader in high-performance specialty materials, today announced that it has reached a key milestone for a next-generation foam blowing agent and plans to begin sampling the developmental candidate with selected global customers in early 2027. Blowing agents are used to create the cellular structure of insulating foams. Used in building insulation, appliances, insulated panels and other rigid foam products, these technologies help improve energy efficiency by reducing the energy required to heat, cool and refrigerate buildings and equipment.


The developmental candidate was designed to meet key characteristics sought by customers for next-generation foam blowing agent applications, including thermal performance, nonflammability, low global warming potential and approximately zero ozone depletion potential. Based on Solstice's internal evaluation, this innovative developmental candidate would not be classified as per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)1. In addition, the developmental candidate would not form trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) in the atmosphere or contribute to its accumulation in the environment2.


"This milestone demonstrates the strength of Solstice's innovation pipeline and the progress we are making through increased investment in R&D," said David Sewell, President and Chief Executive Officer of Solstice. "With more than 300 scientists and engineers and a robust intellectual property portfolio of more than 5,700 patents and pending applications, Solstice is advancing next-generation technologies that help customers address emerging challenges while delivering the consistency and reliability they depend on."


"This next-generation foam blowing agent candidate builds on Solstice's longstanding history of developing advanced technologies for the foam industry," said Jeff Dormo, Senior Vice President, Refrigerants and Applied Solutions, Solstice. "Customers have been very interested in foam blowing agent solutions that would not be classified as PFAS while retaining other important characteristics, and this developmental candidate reflects our commitment to innovation in support of our customers' needs."


During the sampling program, Solstice plans to work with selected global customers to evaluate formulation compatibility, processing behavior and application-specific requirements across spray polyurethane foam, appliance insulation, insulated panels, boardstock and other rigid foam applications.


As Solstice continues to advance this next-generation technology, it will maintain support for its existing portfolio of foam blowing agent solutions. Existing Solstice foam blowing-agent technologies have demonstrated the potential to increase insulation performance by up to 25% in polyisocyanurate boardstock insulation3 and up to 56% in spray polyurethane foam systems4 compared with certain conventional blowing-agent technologies. In appliance insulation applications, Solstice technologies have demonstrated the potential to reduce refrigerator energy consumption by up to 10%5 compared with hydrocarbon-based blowing agents.


For more information about Solstice's foam blowing agents, visit[Solstice.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4817961-1&h=2035896991&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solstice.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fproducts%2Ffoam-blowing-agents&a=Solstice.com) .


**About Solstice Advanced Materials**
Solstice Advanced Materials is a leading global specialty materials company that advances science for smarter outcomes. Solstice offers high-performance solutions that enable critical industries and applications, including refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging and more. Solstice is recognized for developing next-generation materials through some of the industry's most renowned brands such as Solstice®, Genetron®, Aclar®, Spectra®, Fluka™ and Hydranal™. Partnering with over 3,000 customers across more than 120 countries and territories and supported by a robust portfolio of over 5,700 patents and pending applications, Solstice's approximately 4,100 employees worldwide drive innovation in materials science. For more information, visit[www.Solstice.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4817961-1&h=3576837284&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4681669-1%26h%3D209969473%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.Solstice.com%26a%3Dwww.Solstice.com&a=www.Solstice.com) .
